##### Project general facts

Gulfa Towers is a contemporary high-rise residential development offering an elegant urban lifestyle in a prime location on Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Street. The architecture reflects a modern design approach with clean lines, well-balanced proportions, and functional planning that enhances both aesthetics and comfort. The project offers spacious one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each designed with smart layouts and generous balconies that create bright, open living spaces suited for modern city living.

The development provides a well-rounded lifestyle supported by a variety of amenities designed for everyday convenience and comfort. Residents benefit from commercial showrooms located on the ground floor, ensuring essential services are just steps away from home. A curated selection of lifestyle-enhancing facilities is available within the building, offering something for every member of the family and creating a comfortable balance between relaxation and practicality in a central and well-connected location.

Inside, Gulfa Towers features high-end apartment layouts with premium fittings and modern finishing throughout. Interiors are designed to maximise space, light, and functionality, creating a refined and welcoming atmosphere. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, offering both style and practicality for daily use. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their living spaces according to their own preferences and lifestyle needs.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
